subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_spawn child runs fail after acceptance with HTTP 401 Missing scopes api.responses.write

question: Should native `sessions_spawn` inherit the requester session's effective model/runtime/auth profile by default when no explicit child model is configured?
rationale: The docs promise caller inheritance, but the code currently derives child routing from target/global config and this affects auth/provider compatibility and cross-agent behavior.

options.title: Inherit effective requester context
options.body: Update native child-session planning to carry the requester's effective model/runtime/auth profile when no explicit child route is configured, with regression and live-provider proof.

options.title: Keep configured child defaults
options.body: Document that child runs use target/global subagent defaults and add spawn-time validation so unauthorized routes fail before acceptance.

options.title: Resolve OAuth scopes first
options.body: Finish the OpenAI OAuth scope decision in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90536, then re-test whether this native spawn failure remains.

recommendation.title: Inherit effective requester context
recommendation.body: Update native child-session planning to carry the requester's effective model/runtime/auth profile when no explicit child route is configured, with regression and live-provider proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on the subagent spawn planning/model-selection seams and prior sessions_spawn provider inheritance.
